name: metrics-exporter-dead
title: Runtime metrics absent from the store
summary: The daemon's OTLP metrics exporter has stopped delivering runtime series; this store-side absence check is deliberately independent of the exporter it watches.

name: api-backpressure
title: API backpressure rejecting requests
summary: The control plane rejected API requests at its in-flight ceiling.

name: ready-index-write-failure
title: Ready-index writes failing
summary: The control plane failed to update the shared fleet readiness index.

name: runner-silent
title: Runner heartbeat overdue
summary: A runner has not been heard from by ANY daemon replica for longer than the source-derived offline threshold. Two repairs live in this expression: the family reports a Unix epoch, so the age is computed here rather than compared raw; and the per-replica table is never evicted, so the freshest observation per runner is taken before the worst runner is. Either omission makes this rule fire for a healthy fleet.

name: runner-failure
title: Runner execution failed
summary: A runner reported an execution failure.

name: telemetry-discard
title: Telemetry entries discarded
summary: The local OpenTelemetry exporter discarded entries.
